intent: Cuts v0.7.3, the release that makes #78 and #79 reachable. Both are inert without a tag: downstream repos pin the version in the npx spec and in the action reference, so cuspr cannot adopt either fix until this exists. #78 added a `plumbline` bin so the documented `npx -y "git+https://github.com/amos-labs/plumbline#<tag>" <cmd>` quick start resolves a binary instead of exiting 0 with no output. #79 added the `merge-token` input so a lifecycle:auto_merge merge can be attributed to a real identity and therefore fire `push`, plus a loud warning on the GITHUB_TOKEN fallback path. THIRD FIX, FOUND WHILE PREPARING THE RELEASE: PLUMBLINE_VERSION in src/shape.ts was a hand-maintained string literal carrying a 'Keep in sync with package.json — see RELEASING.md' comment, and it had already drifted. v0.7.2 shipped with package.json at 0.7.2 while the gate printed 'gate=plumbline 0.7.1' in every diff-mismatch finding. That is exactly the message a person reads while debugging a producer/gate version skew — the single scenario the constant exists to serve — so a stale value there actively misleads the investigation it is meant to support. It now derives from PLUMB_VERSION (which reads package.json at runtime), so the manual sync step is deleted rather than re-performed. Verified after the change that package.json, PLUMB_VERSION and PLUMBLINE_VERSION all report 0.7.3. CHANGELOG: adds the [0.7.3] section per RELEASING.md step 2 (the release workflow extracts it as the release notes and FAILS if the tag and package.json disagree), and repairs the compare-link block, which had been stale since v0.5.0 — links for 0.6.0, 0.6.1, 0.6.2, 0.7.0, 0.7.1 and 0.7.2 were all missing and [Unreleased] still compared from v0.5.0. Also records honestly that v0.7.2 shipped with no changelog entry at all rather than inventing one after the fact. README's 8 npx invocations move from #v0.7.2 to #v0.7.3. NO BEHAVIOUR CHANGE beyond the version-derivation fix: this is a version bump plus docs. PROTECTED SURFACE: YES — touches src/shape.ts and dist/, so self_modifying is true and human sign-off is required, which is correct for a release commit.

validation_plan.command: Confirm package.json, PLUMB_VERSION and PLUMBLINE_VERSION all report 0.7.3
validation_plan.reason: The release workflow fails if the tag and package.json disagree, and the whole point of this change is that the gate stops misreporting itself.
shape.ts gained an import and lost a literal; the bundle and the tsc layout must both still resolve it.
Full suite, including the guards added by #78 and #79 now that both are on master.

validation_plan.command: Push the v0.7.3 tag and confirm the release workflow builds, tests, matches tag to package.json, and publishes the Release
validation_plan.reason: The release is only real once the workflow accepts it.

execution_evidence.command: Confirm package.json, PLUMB_VERSION and PLUMBLINE_VERSION all report 0.7.3
execution_evidence.output_ref: package.json: 0.7.3 · PLUMB_VERSION (CLI reports): 0.7.3 · PLUMBLINE_VERSION (gate reports): 0.7.3. Before the change the third value was the literal '0.7.1' while the first was '0.7.2'.
333 tests, 333 pass, 0 fail — up from 328 at v0.7.2, the extra 5 being the merge-token guards from #79 and the 3 bin-name guards from #78 (one file overlaps the count).

execution_evidence.command: Push the v0.7.3 tag and confirm the release workflow builds, tests, matches tag to package.json, and publishes the Release
execution_evidence.output_ref: Deliberately not done from this branch. RELEASING.md is explicit that cutting a release is a human-triggered act and that the tag goes on the MERGE commit, not on a branch head — so the tag follows this PR landing on master.

result_summary: v0.7.3 — the release that makes the last two fixes reachable. #78 (npx could not resolve a bin and exited 0 silently) and #79 (auto-merge under GITHUB_TOKEN fires no push, so CD never runs) are both inert until tagged, because downstream pins the version in the npx spec and the action reference. Preparing the release surfaced a third bug: PLUMBLINE_VERSION was a hand-maintained literal that had already drifted, so v0.7.2 shipped with the gate announcing itself as 0.7.1 in exactly the diff-mismatch message people read when debugging version skew. It now derives from package.json, deleting the manual sync step instead of repeating it — verified that all three version sources agree at 0.7.3. CHANGELOG gains the 0.7.3 section required by the release workflow, and its compare-link chain is repaired after drifting since v0.5.0; v0.7.2's missing entry is recorded rather than back-filled with invented notes. tsc clean, 333/333 tests pass. The tag itself is left for the merge commit per RELEASING.md.
